news.Title: 台積電守住平盤、聯發科跌回5千以下  台股收盤跌392.64點收47631點
news.Content:
美股凌晨受到公債殖利率漲破5％影響紛紛走跌，加權指數29日開低走低，盤終仍跌392.64點，收在47631.96點。（圖片來源／信傳媒資料照）

美股昨天雖然下跌，但台積電ADR由黑翻紅，被多頭拉到上漲2.27美元，收在452.88美元，台積電（2330）29日一度漲到2495元，漲了20元，卻在賣壓出籠之下最後收在平盤2475元，但其他權值股聯發科（2454）、台達電（2308）均下跌，使得台股盤終仍下跌392.64點，收在47631.96點，成交量7850億元。

聯發科跌破5千元大關，台股收盤疊392點

美股凌晨受到公債殖利率漲破5％影響紛紛走跌，加權指數29日開低走低，即便盤中台積電大漲20元，但權值股「發哥」聯發科跌破5千元大關以及台達電也大跌3.93％，收在1835元，跌破1900元。日月光（3711）也跌了12元收在687元之下，加權指數收盤跌回4萬8千點以下，收在47631.96點，外資應該是轉為賣超了。

聯發科重跌7.1％，大跌375元，收在4910元，也觸發其他IC設計股下跌，創意（3443）也大跌7％，重跌600元，收在7925元，跌破8千元，朝萬元之路可能還要再等等。

高價股成重災區，創意也跌了7%

高價股成為殖利率高漲的重災區，股王信驊（5274）也大跌440元、收在19395元，川湖（2059）跌235元、收在12115元，健策（3653）小跌25元收在6895元，大立光（3008）跌225元、收在6020元，旺矽（6223）跌230元、收在5185元，漢測（7856）跌290元、收在4315元。還有主動式ETF的最愛、台光電（2383）也跌130元，也是跌破5000元大關。

航運股集體走跌，長榮（2603）跌5元、收在238元，陽明（2609）跌1.2元、收在58.4元，萬海（2615）跌4.5元、收在111元，慧洋KY（2637）跌5.5元，收在95元，台驊控股（2636）跌1.5元收在70.4元。

台塑四寶今日倒是全面走揚，台塑化（6505）大漲8.14％，股價來到94.3元，台化（1326）小漲0.5元收在67.5元，台塑（1301）也小漲0.5元收在64.6元，南亞（1303）上漲3.78％收在247元，南亞手下兩強子公司南電（8046）漲2.42％收在1270元，南亞科（2408）漲0.6％收在506元。

(原始連結)

news.Title: 台股收跌392點 失守5日線量縮至7800億 台塑化逆勢噴8%
news.Content:
台股今（29）日開低走低，盤中雖兩度翻紅，但隨後又迅速翻黑，一度下挫逾400點，終場收47637點失守5日線，下跌392點，跌幅0.82%，成交量量縮至7800億，櫃買指數也下跌0.18%，收412.25點。

權值股部分，台積電收2475元平盤，聯發科失守5000元關卡來到4910元，下跌逾7%，台達電下跌3.93%，收1835元，大立光也有逾3%的跌幅。

觀察今日盤面，資金聚焦台塑四寶，台塑化領軍上漲收94.3元，大漲逾8%，成交量約4萬張，南亞開高走高來到247元，上漲3.78%，台化、台塑分別來到67.5元、64.6元。

記憶體族群則集體回神，早盤開低後由黑翻紅，華邦電來到174元，上漲1.46%，旺宏來到118.5元，漲1.28%，力積電收72.3元，上漲0.42%，南亞科也有0.6%的漲幅，終場收506元。

（封面圖／東森新聞）

news.Title: 台股中秋連假後首日開盤走弱 終場重挫392點失守48K
news.Content:
面對美伊局勢、國際油價和美債殖利率等變數影響；台股今（29）日早盤以47873.89點開出，隨後一路震盪走綠，加權指數最低跌至47573.09，終場大跌392.64點，收在47631.96點，跌幅0.82%，成交量7850.39億元，在中秋連假後第一日開盤即失守48K！

news.Title: 今日台股》電子股軟腳！聯發科遭空軍襲擊跌7%　台股終場下跌392點
news.Content:
今日個股成交量排行榜前五名：友達、聯電、群創、南亞、嘉晶

今日個股成交值排行榜前五名：台積電、聯發科、台達電、國巨*、臻鼎-KY

在美伊戰爭、美債殖利率飆高等影響下，美國股市週一全數走跌，其中費半下跌逾1%；不僅如此，亞洲股市昨日也應聲下殺，台北股市今（29）日受到賣壓襲擊，開盤下跌150.71點，以47,873.89點開出，鄰近午盤賣壓加重，跌點擴大，終場下跌392.64點或0.82%，收在47,631.96點，成交量為7,850.39億元。

中小型股同步走低，櫃買指數開盤下跌0.43點，以412.56點開出，盤中一度翻紅，但仍不敵賣壓，終場下跌0.74點或0.18%，收在412.25點，成交量為1,815.78億元。

權值股多數走低，權王台積電將在10月15日舉辦法說會，營運展望、先進製程藍圖以及資本支出將成法人關注重點，今日以平盤價2,475元開出，早盤最高來到2,495元，不過隨後遇到賣壓襲擊，終場收在平盤價2,475元。

IC設計大廠聯發科受到利空消息拖累，市場消息指出，部分終端客戶對採用聯發科晶片仍抱持疑慮，相較之下，更傾向選擇博通、邁威爾（Marvell）等已有成熟量產實績的業者，今日開盤下跌135元，以5,150元開出，隨後一路走低，最低來到4,890元，失守5,000元關卡，終場下跌375元或7.1%，收在4,910元。

受惠國際油價走高、煉油利差優勢，盤面資金輪動至傳產股，由塑化股逆勢走強，台塑化上漲逾8%，南亞上漲逾3%。

此外，晶圓代工族群也有買單撐腰，半導體設備界傳出消息，台積電擬規劃啟動美國第二園區建廠作業，落腳德州達拉斯呼聲高。此計畫擬興建六座先進晶圓廠，總投資額預估超越亞利桑那州的2,650億美元（折合新台幣約為8.4兆），因此相關設備股也聞訊走強，雷科、陽程、瑞耘、萬潤攻上漲停板，友威科上漲逾8%，昇陽半導體上漲逾7%，倍利科上漲逾6%。

矽晶圓族群也有買單敲進，昇陽半導體、嘉晶上漲逾7%，辛耘上漲逾2%。

news.Title: 國際資金緊俏＋油價高攀，國際股市拉回等待10月再起
news.Content:
【財訊快報／方亞申】經過國際油價走升以及美國10年期及30年期公債殖利率竄至近10年高點，美股週一出現較大震盪，不過不如週一亞股嚴重。台股長假過後開盤傳出台積電(2330)要去美國德州建第二園區，總金額超過2650億美元，中小型設備股族群聞訊上漲。台積電相關股多數都跟著上漲；塑化有油價上漲，金融股有殖利率護身，使台股盤中跌幅相對其他亞洲股市為低，不過高價股表現還是比較弱勢，終場指數收在47631.96點，下跌392.64點、0.82%，成交量萎縮至7850.39億元，市場資金似乎的確較為緊俏了!國際政經情勢不明朗，美伊打打談談，國際油價居高不下，看來還有一個月的美國期中選舉前跌幅有限。通膨陰影籠罩。再者AI所衍伸的通膨，在記憶體沒有下跌前，CPU也蠢蠢欲動，台積電晶片代工價格也看漲，再看看銅價、矽電容、CCL等等，無一不看漲，自然推動未來新的AI伺服器價格推升。此時ASIC剛好抬頭，預計明年市占率可能近一步上升，對於谷歌、微軟、亞馬遜、臉書等有加分作用。不過輝達護城河廣大，且貸款給中小企業購買、折舊，各公司有不同做法，為的就是要將市場衝大。而這次華爾街也被捲進做融資業務，並稱黃仁勳為老師，AI趨勢勢不可擋。連這次中國內耗後都傳出將再次開放輝達AI伺服器進口。

美國總統川普拒絕伊朗停火及重啟荷姆茲海峽方案，油價、美債殖利率還是在高檔，亞股及美股同步承壓。利率繼石油後成為通膨主因。

所幸塑化股及金融股上漲、台積電還能頂住，時序即將進入第四季，投資機構普遍認為多頭格局尚未改變，台股10日線及20日線上升至46,000-47,000點是多空必守。對第四季行情偏多看待，推估全年高點在第四季，區間50,000～55,000點，50,000點儼然成了今年高點預估值的基本盤。

由於台積電將到美國設第二工業園區，設備股幾乎全面上漲，包括弘塑(3131)、辛耘(3583)、萬潤(6187)、均華(6640)、志聖(2467)、雷科(6207)、昇鈦(8027)；材料分析與檢測汎銓(6830)、德律(3030)、家登(3680)、昇陽半導體(8028)、中砂(1560)都上漲。再則CPO還是有一定買盤，包括聯鈞(3450)、華星光(4979)；CCL有台光電(2383)、台虹(8039)、亞電(4939)。ABF則有南電(8046)、臻鼎(4958)；工業電腦的研華(2395)、艾訊(3088)、樺漢(6414)、宸曜(6922)、廣積(8050)、陽程(3498)，其他還有GIS(6456)、順達(3211)等中小型股表現較為不錯。

國際油價逼近100美元，川普過去放話不要炸俄羅斯柴油，否則價格上漲，如今正是如此，對於台特化(4772)、新應材(4749)、勝一(1773)、台塑化(6505)有利，加上南亞(1303)、南電、南亞科(2408)獲利都有一定水準，今年將是台塑集團豐收年，抵抗傳產拉回。航運則扮演防守角色。

金融股有已出售股票轉入盈餘公積可配發股息優勢，預計明年配息不錯，包括富邦金(2881)、國泰金(2882)、凱基金(2883)、中信金(2891)等。

news.Title: 台股跌392.64點
news.Content:
（中央社台北29日電）台北股市今天震盪收跌，收盤跌392.64點，為47631.96點，跌幅0.82%，成交金額新台幣7850.39億元。

加權指數開盤為47873.89點，盤中最高48045.13點，最低47573.09點；不含金融股指數42513.28點，跌361.43點。

八大類股漲跌幅：泥窯股跌0.70%、食品股跌0.75%、塑化股漲1.97%、紡織股跌0.80%、機電股跌1%、造紙股跌1.33%、營建股跌1.01%、金融股跌0.54%。

委買張數2343萬892張，委賣張數1345萬4643張，成交張數954萬3966張。

收盤時上漲381家，下跌602家，持平122家。

成交量前5名個股為主動中信台灣收益、友達、群益臺灣加權正2、復華富時不動產、凱基台灣TOP50。

漲幅前5名個股為柏騰、台亞、晶心科、GIS-KY、美亞。

news.Title: 2大利空夾擊 台股收盤重挫392點！台積電收最低殺回平盤
news.Content:
美伊談判無進展，油價、美國公債殖利率雙雙走揚，衝擊美股周一四大指數全數下跌，台股今（29）日早盤一度翻紅，但隨後翻黑湧現賣壓，最低來到47573.09點，收盤下跌392.64點，以47631.96點作收，成交量7850億。

台積電一度漲至2495元，隨後漲幅收斂收在2475元，聯發科重挫逾7%收4910元，主因法人圈盛傳TPU V9開發進度、訂單分配及客戶驗證出現新的不確定性。台達電亦下殺逾5%，鴻海殺回平盤。

資金轉進成熟製程、面板股，世界先進逆勢走揚漲逾4%，友達漲逾2%。

鍾昆禎分析師表示，油價持續在100上下震盪，美債殖利率來到5.2%，外在總經壓力還未完全解除，預期大盤震盪以個股表現為主。

台股連假前24日收48024.60點，下跌132.69點或0.28%，總成交值7755.91億元。三大法人賣超444.49億元，外資賣超329.65億元，投信、自營商賣超128.23億元及買超13.38億元。

美股周一全面下挫。美股道瓊下跌347.11點或0.67%，收51,481.51點。S&P500下跌59.72點或0.77%，收7,683.69點。NASDAQ下跌248.34點或0.92%，收26,820.38點。費城半導體下跌203.69點或1.61%，收12,465.24點。

news.Title: Stock-Split Watch: Is Meta Platforms Next?
news.Content:
Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META) closed at $751.66 on Sept. 25, nearly 30% above its Sept. 1 closing price, despite pulling back roughly 3.3% in the latest session. The stock had reached a new 52-week high of $779.82 just a day earlier.

Rising enthusiasm around the launch of its new Muse artificial intelligence (AI) assistant has helped fuel this rally. Reuters reported that Meta Platforms' shares had already gained more than 20% following Muse's launch on Sept. 8. This jump resulted in more than a $310 billion increase in the company's market value by Sept. 22.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

The sharp rise in share price has strengthened the case for Meta Platforms as a potential stock-split candidate. The company remains the only "Magnificent Seven" member that has never completed a conventional stock split .

Here's a case for a stock split that may be getting stronger.

Case for a potential stock split

Meta Platforms' shares still trade above $750 even after the Sept. 25 pullback. While a stock split would not change the company's intrinsic value, it could make the shares more accessible to employees and investors by lowering the nominal price per share. Both Nvidia and Apple cited greater accessibility as a reason for their previous stock splits.

The growing availability of fractional shares, however, has reduced one of the traditional reasons for stock splits. Investors using brokers that support fractional trading can invest any desired amount in Meta Platforms without buying a full share.

Fractional shares do not make Meta Platforms' high nominal share price completely irrelevant. A standard U.S. equity options contract generally represents 100 shares. At Meta Platforms' Sept. 25 closing price, the options contract represents roughly $75,166 in underlying stock value. A stock split could therefore make some options strategies involving the standard 100-share lots more accessible.

Could Meta Platforms' higher share price strengthen the case for a stock split?

The more relevant question may be whether Meta Platforms' higher share price proves durable. The company briefly traded near $800 in 2025, reaching an intraday high of $796.25 on Aug. 15, without subsequently completing a stock split. This time, however, investors are increasingly betting that Muse could become a meaningful new business for the company.

Story Continues

The early evidence is promising. According to Apptopia, the Muse AI assistant attracted 2.8 million downloads in its first 12 days. Reuters also reported that 57 of 64 brokerages covering the company had rated it a "buy" or higher by Sept. 22. Bloomberg also reported that Muse had climbed to the top of both the U.S. Apple App Store and Google Play rankings, with more than 902,000 downloads in its first six days since launch.

Meta Platforms also unveiled its dedicated Muse Charm device at its September Connect event. If the stock holds these levels rather than giving back the Muse-driven gains, the practical case for lowering the nominal share price with a stock split could become stronger.

Management's latest comments still leave room for a future split. In May 2026, CFO Susan Li said Meta Platforms did not "presently" plan one but would keep monitoring market conditions and investor feedback. Since then, the changes in those conditions have made a potential stock split more plausible.

news.Title: 力旺再獲台積OIP開放創新平台夥伴獎，NeoFuse OTP已導入N2製程開發
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者李純君報導】嵌入式非揮發性記憶體（eNVM）矽智財供應商力旺電子(3529)今日發出官方新聞稿，宣布連續第17年榮獲台積電(2330)Open Innovation Platform（OIP）年度合作夥伴獎，公司也揭露，NeoFuse OTP已經針對台積電N2製程的矽開發。同時，NeoFuse OTP獲AI與HPC採用。力旺提到，自家的NeoFuse OTP矽智財已在台積電N7至N3製程上完成量產驗證，並啟動針對台積電N2（2奈米）製程的矽智財開發。同時，NeoFuse OTP也在AI與HPC晶片上擔任重要角色：從校正參數與記憶體修復以提升良率與可靠度，到作為硬體信任根儲存層，保存識別碼及金鑰。

力旺揭露，NeoFuse OTP已於台積電N7與N6進入穩定量產，並在N5、N4、N3等製程節點取得設計採用（design win）。今年，力旺也已完成N3C與N2P的測試晶片設計定案（test chip tape-out），並推進N2及後續世代節點的矽智財開發與布局。截至目前，已有超過840項力旺矽智財導入台積電的製程技術。

力旺的IP應用於各類終端市場，其中AI與HPC晶片是NeoFuse OTP目前較為熱門的應用場域。OTP macro在晶片上承擔多項任務，包含儲存開機程式修補碼以縮短上市時程、支援晶片上高密度SRAM的記憶體修復、保存多核心晶片的PVT感測器校正碼，並作為硬體信任根的儲存層，提供Caliptra所需的唯一識別碼、安全儲存與亂數源。在異質整合封裝中，這也讓身分識別得以延伸至每一顆晶粒。隨著physical AI將運算推向終端裝置與實體系統，對晶片身分識別與安全儲存的需求同步成長，已經有多家客戶使用在AI晶片應用上。

力旺董事長徐清祥表示：「推動我們開發新一代IP的，是市場與應用端的需求。今年有兩項驅動力特別明確：一是先進運算平台採用N2，二是在多晶粒封裝中，需要為每一顆晶粒建立硬體層級的信任根基。要把這些需求落實到矽晶片上，需要一個能一起往前走的製程夥伴，而OIP生態系正是驗證這些工作的場域。」

news.Title: 台積電傳砸逾8.4兆赴德州！ 擬再蓋6座晶圓廠 「美南半導體雙核」版圖曝光
news.Content:
台積電擴大美國製造版圖再傳新進展。半導體設備業界近日傳出，台積電繼亞利桑那州後，正評估啟動美國第二座園區，地點鎖定德州達拉斯，規畫再興建6座先進晶圓廠，總投資金額甚至可能超越亞利桑那州目前規畫的2650億美元，折合新台幣約8.4兆元。不過，相關消息目前仍屬業界傳聞，台積電尚未正式證實，董事會也尚未拍板。

傳德州成第二基地 6座晶圓廠規模受矚目

根據《聯合報》報導，據業界人士透露，「台積電赴德州蓋新廠」的消息近期在半導體供應鏈間流傳，多家不具名供應商也表示曾聽聞相關說法，但目前並未接獲台積電正式通知或要求提前準備。市場推測，若第二園區成案，未來將導入更先進製程，因此整體投資規模可能高於亞利桑那州。德州達拉斯及北德州素有「矽草原」之稱，當地已有德儀、三星、Coherent、特斯拉等企業布局，具備半導體、光通訊及相關產業聚落，有利形成供應鏈群聚。

美國客戶占營收逾7成 海外投資持續加碼

台積電近年持續擴大海外布局，主要考量包括貼近主要客戶、分散地緣政治風險，以及因應土地、水電等資源限制。目前亞利桑那州廠區總投資規模已達2650億美元，規畫打造6座晶圓廠、2座先進封裝廠及1座研發中心。台積電2026年上半年美國客戶營收占比約75.64%，加上AI、高效能運算需求持續成長，使美國在地製造布局受到市場高度關注。相較之下，德州具有人才、電力及稅負等條件，也被業界視為潛在選址之一。

10/15法說會成焦點 資本支出是否再創高受矚目

台積電目前2026年資本支出預估為600億至640億美元，創歷史新高，主要投入先進製程及先進封裝。外界也將目光鎖定10月15日法說會，除了2奈米量產進度、A14製程及AI需求外，海外廠區擴建與德州設廠傳聞是否獲得公司說明，也可能成為法人關注焦點。若台積電最終啟動德州第二園區，除了擴大美國在地產能，也可能進一步串起亞利桑那與德州的半導體供應鏈布局。

（封面圖／台積電提供）

news.Title: 國際利空夾擊 台股秋節長假後開市欲振乏力
news.Content:
台北股市歷經中秋以及教師節長假後，今天(29日)迎來開盤首日，但受美伊局勢緊張、美債殖利率處於5.2%的相對高檔，指數欲振乏力，午盤前48,000點失守，成交量能預估將低於新台幣兆元。

台北股市在中秋與教師節長假期間，幾項國際政經局勢與海外金融市場變化，影響秋節後台股的開盤表現。

首先是全球矚目的美中領導人會面落幕，雖然雙方以對等方式調降總額各300億美元的非敏感商品關稅，但兩國並未發表聯合聲明，讓市場觀望後續發展。

其次是美伊談判仍觸礁，使得國際油價止跌反彈。由於美國強勁的經濟數據，再加上油價回升，加深市場對聯準會將拉長高利率時間或於10月再度升息疑慮，導致美國長天期公債殖利率狂飆，對於高估值的科技股以及半導體股造成壓力。

另外，亞洲主要股市在本週一全面收跌。韓國股市因記憶體巨頭三星與SK海力士遭資金大舉拋售重挫2.7%，日本股市高低震盪逾千點並以下跌486點作收，美股四大指數也疲弱。受國際各利空夾擊，台股29日迎來長假後開盤首日，呈現欲振乏力，午盤前最低來到47,573點，下跌逾450點，失守48,000點大關。分析師簡伯儀說：『(原音)整個基本面或者是說訊息面，或者是國際之間的紛爭，還是比較明顯沒有做正向發展的情況下，今天指數就有出現一個拉回修正的狀況。盤中雖然說曾經試圖反彈，但是在整個OTC的個股來看，有跌破短期5日均線支撐的情況下，股價有一點在這邊轉弱。』

匯市部分，受美債殖利率飆升，美元指數轉強，新台幣兌美元匯價29日一開盤呈現走貶，午盤前一度攀至最低31.838元價位，但也一度走高至31.76元，呈現震盪波動。

news.Title: 台積聯發科等14大企業搶先進駐！國發會矽谷辦公室揭牌 攬才湧進3千人次
news.Content:
國發會主委葉俊顯、數發部次長楊佳玲與工研院董事長吳政忠率領代表團，攜手政大、中正、中山、台科大、北科大及中研院等學研機構，前進矽谷展開海外攬才與人才交流行動。國發會於9月25日在矽谷正式啟用Talent Taiwan首個海外據點，並於隔天（26日）在「2026北美台灣科技年會」（Taiwan Tech Summit）舉辦Taiwan Career Day，將台灣產學研機構上千個職缺直接帶到矽谷，包括台積電 （2330-TW）(TSM-US)、聯發科(2454-TW) 等「護國神山群」亦跟進入駐，從人才服務到就業媒合，進一步拓展全球攬才網絡。

葉俊顯率產學研代表團赴美，正式啟用Talent Taiwan首個海外據點「Talent Taiwan矽谷辦公室」，並在「2026北美台灣科技年會」舉辦Taiwan Career Day。本次行動攜手台積電、聯發科等14家指標企業與學研機構，釋出上千個半導體、資通訊、軟體及AI領域職缺，提供一對一快速面試，吸引超過3000人次熱烈參與，展現台灣搶奪國際頂尖人才的決心。

國發會表示，為了深入海外人才聚落並強化與國際專業人才的連結，「Talent Taiwan矽谷辦公室」特別設於Startup Island TAIWAN矽谷新創基地。葉俊顯指出，台灣持續發展AI、半導體等關鍵產業，面對全球人才競爭，首個海外攬才據點落腳全球科技人才重鎮矽谷，就是希望將人才服務直接帶到人才所在地，推廣台灣工作及發展機會。葉俊顯並於活動現場頒發就業金卡予Salesforce資深軟體工程師Michael Foley，期盼吸引更多國際專業人才來台發展。

國發會Talent Taiwan與TaiwanNext Foundation於年會期間共同舉辦Taiwan Career Day，將「台灣上千個職缺直接帶到矽谷攬才」，讓國際人才不僅認識台灣，更能直接與企業面試媒合。同日，Startup Island TAIWAN矽谷新創基地亦舉辦Taiwan Demo Day活動，由12家台灣新創或具備與台灣合作的國際新創同台較勁，展現台灣的新創實力和產業優勢，並爭取由Industrial Technology Investment Company（ITIC）支持的1.8萬美元獎金。

本次國發會與數發部攜手14家台灣企業赴美攬才，包括立創科技、台達電 (2308-TW)、台積電 、台灣大哥大 (3045-TW)、台灣先藝科技、台灣美光、台灣應用材料公司、艾斯特拉、拓布拉、東京威力科創、滿拓科技、緯創 (3231-TW)、聯發科等，聚焦半導體、資通訊、軟體及AI等熱門領域；工研院、中研院及多家大專校院亦提供研究與教研職缺，安排現場一對一快速面試。

此外，國發會、數發部、內政部移民署、教育部、經濟部及駐外館處（僑教中心）於現場擺攤宣傳攬才與就業金卡等政策，當日整體活動吸引超過3000人次參與，交流盛況空前。國發會強調，未來將持續整合跨部會資源，建立與北美人才社群的常態化合作機制，透過實體據點串聯台美新創與人才，深化台灣國際人才鏈結與新創生態系發展。

news.Title: 台股「這時」上看10萬點？學者曝美分析師推算邏輯：台積電股價遠不只5000元
news.Content:
台積電 股價表現向來是投資人關注焦點。（資料照，柯承惠攝）

​台股經歷中秋連假4日休市，投資人關注今（29）日開盤狀況。總體經濟學家 吳嘉隆 28日在臉書以「台積電股價幾年後有希望看到8000（元）」為題分享，台灣分析師估算台積電（2330）股價時的簡單算法是，隨著台積電新產能漸漸開出，獲利和營收將隨之升高，幾年後有望看到5000元；但美國分析師對台積電ADR（TSM）另有個推算方式，預估台積電股價很可能在4、5年後站上8000元，翻了3倍。截至上周四連假前收盤，台積電股價為2475元。

台灣分析師：台積電股價上看5000元

吳嘉隆指出，台積電股價目前在$2400上下震盪，若真翻倍，屆時台股大盤指數也可能跟著翻倍，權值股如鴻海，廣達，大立光，聯發科，日月光控股等應也會隨之上漲；目前大盤約在48000點，翻倍再湊個整數，也就是10萬點。單就股價看，台灣分析師算法方面，吳嘉隆指出，在營收和獲利走高下， 台積電EPS可能從2026年估計的100翻倍至200，本益比維持在合理的25倍，幾年後台積電股價有望看到5000元 。

美國分析師如何估算台積電ADR股價？​

美國分析師估算方面，吳嘉隆表示，他們依照3個層次展開推算，包含：

news.Title: 國際資金緊俏，全面拉回等待10月再起
news.Content:
【財訊快報／方亞申】經過國際油價走升以及美國10年期及30年期公債殖利率竄至近10年高點，美股週一出現較大震盪，不過不如週一亞股嚴重。台股長假過後開盤傳出台積電(2330)要去美國德州建第二園區，總金額超過2650億美元，設備股族群聞訊上漲。台積電相關股幾乎都跟著漲；塑化有油價上漲，金融股有殖利率護身，使台股週二盤中跌幅明顯較亞洲股市小，但高價股表現還是比較弱。國際政經情勢不明朗，美伊陷入談談打打循環，國際油價居高不下，看來在一個月的美中期中選舉跌幅有限。再者AI所衍伸的通膨，在記憶體未下跌前，CPU也蠢蠢欲動，台積電晶片代工價格也看漲，銅價、矽電容、CCL等等，無一不看漲，自然推動未來新的AI伺服器價格推升。此時ASIC剛好抬頭，預計明年市占率可能進一步上升，對於谷歌、微軟、亞馬遜、臉書等有加分作用。不過輝達護城河廣大，且貸款給中小企業購買、折舊，各公司有不同做法，為的就是要將市場衝大。而這次華爾街也被捲進做融資業務，並稱黃仁勳為老師，AI趨勢勢不可擋。連這次中國內耗後都傳出將再次開放輝達AI伺服器進口。

美國總統川普拒絕伊朗停火及重啟荷姆茲海峽方案，油價、美債殖利率28日再度走高，亞股及美股同步承壓。指數終場未見大跌。時序即將進入第四季，投資機構普遍認為多頭格局尚未改變，台股10日線及20日線上升至47000點是多空必守。對第四季行情偏多看待，推估全年高點在第四季，從50,000～55,000點，50,000點儼然成了今年高點預估值的基本盤。

由於台積電突發將到美國設第二工業園區，設備股幾乎全面上漲，包括弘塑 ( 3131 )、辛耘( 3583 )、萬潤( 6187 )、均華( 6640 )、志聖( 2467 )、雷科( 6207 )、鈦昇( 8027 )；材料分析與檢測汎銓( 6830 )、德律( 3030 )。家登( 3680 )、昇陽半導體( 8028 )、中砂( 1560 )都上漲。CPO還是有一定買盤，包括聯鈞( 3450 )、華新光( 4979 )。CCL有台光電( 2383 )。

國際油價逼近100美元，川普過去放話不要炸俄羅斯柴油，否則價格上漲，如今正是如此，對於台特化( 4772 )、新應材( 4749 )、勝一( 1773 )、台塑化( 6505 )有利，加上南亞( 1303 )、南電( 8046 )、南亞科( 2408 )獲利都有一定水準，今年將是台塑集團豐收年，抵抗傳產拉回。航運則扮演防守角色。

金融股有已出售股票轉入盈餘公積可配發股息優勢，預計明年配息不錯，包括富邦金( 2881 )、國泰金( 2882 )、凱基金( 2883 )、玉山金( 2884 )。

news.Title: 與台積電合作碳封存　台塑化林克彥：不是1年、2年的事
news.Content:
（中央社記者曾仁凱台北2026年9月29日電）台積電積極尋找低碳、無碳電力，找上台塑化合作碳封存，搭配台塑集團進行中的麥寮電廠改建天然氣機組案，希望取得更多低碳電力來源。台灣科技與傳產兩大龍頭聯手合作備受外界矚目，不過台塑化總經理林克彥坦言，這後面還有許多事需要克服，不是1年、2年的事。

林克彥告訴中央社記者，台塑化早從2022年就開始投入碳捕捉、碳封存的探索，初期與中央大學合作，在麥寮濱海區域進行地質調查二氧化碳封存潛能評估，「本來是台塑化自己做，現在台積電也加入。」

據了解，由台塑集團投資的麥寮電廠改建天然氣機組案工程正在進行中，預計2029年底2部新建各120萬瓩的燃氣複循環機組將進入商轉，台積電希望麥寮新電廠如果搭配新的碳封存技術，能取得新的低碳電力來源。

林克彥表示，目前初步評估結果，顯示台灣西部沿海地層具有良好的天然地質條件、且遠離斷層，可提升封存安全性。但這個還要進一步驗證，包括進行灌注測試，檢查洩漏風險，確保安全無虞。

至於最後能不能大規模封存，林克彥表示這還得申請環評，與地方政府、環保團體溝通，很多事需要克服，「不是1年、2年的事。」

據了解，此次台塑化與台積電合作碳封存，初步會先做1個試驗場，之後再視情況進行大規模的捕捉與封存。

為達到碳中和目標，碳捕捉、利用與封存（CarbonCapture, Utilization and Storage，簡稱CCUS）技術，是運用科技方法達到負碳效果，被視為未來的低碳解方之一。台塑化因同時擁有碳源、廠址等資源，很早就開始投入碳捕捉與碳封存技術探索。

台塑化2022年與清華大學合作，在雲林麥寮廠執行「每日捕捉1噸二氧化碳示範計畫」，利用醇胺吸收液，通過超重力旋轉床，捕獲汽電共生機組煙道氣中的二氧化碳。林克彥說，現在碳捕捉技術逐漸成熟，已經不是太大問題，接下來就看怎麼把捕捉到二氧化碳再利用或是封存起來。

news.Title: 美股閃現兩大「危險信號」動搖投資人信心
news.Content:
《Yahoo Finance》報導，目前儘管汽油價格居高不下、美國公債殖利率持續上升，標普500指數仍在歷史高點附近，這確實能帶給市場一些信心。但如果仔細觀察市場表面之下，其實目前存在不少危險信號。

以下是摩根士丹利的Mike Wilson及其策略團隊所提出的兩項訊號：

市場廣度疲弱

今年夏季，高於200日移動平均線的標普500成分股比例一度升至約75%，但如今已降至49%。

Wilson表示，「重要的是，當原油價格與殖利率同步走高時，市場廣度仍在擴大。」

他進一步指出，「更明顯的惡化是在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)之後出現。對我們而言，這意味著近期市場廣度的縮小，更多反映的是市場正在消化進一步緊縮貨幣政策的預期。」

換句話說，雖然標普500指數本身仍接近高點，但真正參與上漲的股票數量正在減少。

大型股正遭遇重挫

自6月以來，羅素3000指數約有51%的成分股，至少經歷了20%回檔。

按照市場技術定義，跌幅達20%或以上就進入熊市區域。也就是說，即使整體大盤仍看起來非常強勁，市場內部其實已經有相當多股票出現大幅下跌。

news.Title: 【台股盤中】指數跌逾400點　聯發科、台達電回檔
news.Content:
（中央社記者吳家豪台北2026年9月29日電）受國際地緣政治與利率不確定性尚存、油價走揚影響，台股今天開低震盪，盤中最低觸及47573點、下跌451點，5日線約47860點暫時失守，呈現高檔震盪整理格局。

11時17分左右，台股加權指數為47639點，下跌385點，跌幅0.8%，成交值新台幣4994億元；電子類股指數下挫1.1%，金融類股上揚0.4%。

觀察盤面焦點，電子權值股台積電 (2330) 表現撐盤，盤中最高漲至2495元、小漲約0.8%；聯發科 (2454) 、台達電 (2308) 跌勢加深，盤中下跌超過7%、4%；大立光 (3008) 失守6000元，盤中最低5940元、跌幅4.8%。

傳產與防禦型族群相對抗跌，具綠能、重電政策題材支持的機電類股表現有撐，東元 (1504) 上漲約0.44%，中興電 (1513) 走揚約0.3%。

美國總統川普（Donald Trump）週末期間拒絕伊朗提出的停火方案，國際油價再度走高。塑膠族群今天表現搶眼，台塑化 (6505) 盤中最高達95.5元、勁揚9.5%；南亞 (1303) 漲逾2%，台塑 (1301) 、台化 (1326) 漲逾1%。

news.Title: 台股中秋收假拉回！法人統計歷年10月進場勝算高　一表掌握
news.Content:
台股結束中秋節連假，今天早盤拉回修正，截至發稿為止，下跌約3百餘點，且盤中還一度翻紅。

展望後市，群益投信認為，過往經驗來看，第4季至隔年第1季為台股旺季，加權指數與電子指數表現亮眼，加上全球AI需求強勁，相關供應鏈股多點開花，因此在旺季效應與AI浪潮雙重推動下，9月底進場布局台股後市表現可期，而大型科技龍頭股與AI趨勢帶起的重點題材股，更可說是台股投資必備，建議投資人可透過主動式市值型台股ETF來掌握行情。

主動群益核心50 (00415A)經理人許育誌表示，台股歷經AI浪潮後，股市結構已逐漸轉為具爆發力的科技成長型市場，隨著AI發展持續推升台廠獲利動能，台股走勢有望持續由獲利成長驅動。

再者，過往台股存在Q4～Q1旺季效應，統計自2000年以來加權指數Q4平均報酬4.21%、電子指數4.64%，Q1則分為4.57%和5.79%，亦即在9月底、10月初布局台股，除持續緊跟AI科技行情，還能同步掌握旺季行情。

在產業佈局方面，科技股仍是投資核心，包括晶圓代工、PCB/CCL、ABF、半導體測試、IC設計、網通等值得持續留意。

大華銀投信指數量化投資部門主管郭修誠表示，這波由AI基礎建設（AI基建）引爆的萬億美元浪潮，正全力由美國、台灣與韓國三地強勢主導。美國憑藉科技七巨頭（Magnificent 7）壟斷頂級算力研發與軟體生態；台灣扮演全球AI硬體製造、光通訊傳輸與伺服器高階組裝的樞紐；韓國則穩坐高頻寬記憶體（HBM）與先進晶片的產能霸主。三地鏈接，構築出全球AI供應鏈最堅固的「美台韓AI黃金三角」，並宣告AI基建動能將一路延伸至2027年。

郭修誠指出，面對通膨與殖利率波動的總經環境，全球科技巨頭對AI基礎建設的資本支出不減反增。從運算端的GPU晶片、傳輸端的高速光模組，到儲存端的高頻寬記憶體，AI基建正經歷全方位的規格升級。特別是在新一代GPU平台與大型語言模型規模急速擴大的背景下，伺服器間的資料傳輸量急升，帶動800G及1.6T光模組加速導入，CPO（共同封裝光學）新架構躍升為AI基建不可或缺的關鍵環節。

郭修誠形容：「在宏觀經濟的強風巨浪下，單打獨鬥的個股就像孤單的俠客，再厲害也打不過一支組織嚴密、規模龐大的AI軍隊。」針對這波AI長線投資題材。

展望第4季，郭修誠表示，AI浪潮持續擴大「算力、傳輸、記憶體」三大核心紅利。建議投資人不妨善用美、台、韓「黃金三角」009815、00918與009829組成美台韓黃金三角明星隊，採取分批布局策略，以在多變的總經環境中，精準鎖定 AI 基礎建設的長線成長動能。

news.Title: 9月消費信心創一年半新高 台股走強投資人仍居高思危
news.Content:
中央大學今天(29日)公布9月消費者信心指數(CCI)為68.77點，較上月上升3.76點，創去年4月以來、約一年半新高，六大分項指標全面上揚，以投資股票時機增幅最大。不過，學者指出，台股走強，民眾卻未必認為適合進場，除了居高思危，大盤與櫃買市場表現分歧，也讓投資信心回升幅度受到限制。

中央大學台灣經濟發展研究中心在訪問3,182位台灣地區20歲以上民眾後公布9月消費者信心調查，總指數由8月的65.01點升至68.77點，包括物價水準、家庭經濟狀況、國內經濟景氣、就業機會、投資股票時機及購買耐久性財貨等六項指標同步上升，但從絕對水準來看，仍全數落在偏悲觀區間。

其中，投資股票時機指標月增7.7點至35.42點，增幅最大，創去年11月以來新高；國內經濟景氣指標上升5.82點至87.02點，家庭經濟狀況指標則增加4.52點至82.64點，分居第二、第三。

對於股市創新高，投資股票時機指標卻長期低迷，中央大學台經中心執行長吳大任表示，由於問卷設計是「未來半年是否為好的購買時機」，所以即使投資人對後市有信心，也可能因為股價偏高、擔心進場後套牢，而回答不適合買進，未來可能會增加新的獨立指標來呈現。他說：『(原音)我們這個問題事實上我個人是認為，它其實也沒有辦法真正完全反映股市的信心。不過我想因為我們這個調查也做了20幾年，那我們一向都是問這樣的一個問題，那所以說為了維持資料的一致性，所以我們現在也沒有辦法去做調整，或許將來我們可以再想看看有沒有什麼樣的問項、再用另外一個獨立的指標來問這個問題。』

中央大學經濟系教授姚睿進一步分析，這次調查期間，加權指數已幾乎收復6月的歷史收盤高點，但代表較多中小型企業的櫃買指數，距離前波高點仍有落差。兩個市場表現分歧，也可能讓投資人維持保守態度，出現大盤走強、投資信心卻未同步升溫的現象。

她也指出，近期出口及外銷訂單表現強勁下，原先對下半年成長動能放緩的擔憂已有所緩解。不過，中東衝突及通膨壓力仍未消退，國際債券殖利率上升，也可能推高企業籌資成本，並對股票估值帶來壓力。(編輯：沈鎮江)

news.Title: 對台積電下戰書！三星電子：2029年晶圓代工客戶將增至2017年的4倍左右
news.Content:
南韓三星電子周二(29日)釋出晶圓代工中長期擴客目標，代工事業部高層盧美貞表示，以2017年該業務首度獨立法人為基準，目前客戶數已增至約3倍，預計2029年進一步達到約4倍，由現有以行動裝置為主轉向AI與高效能運算(HPC)擴張。

《韓聯社》報導，HPC相關佔三星電子營收比重2017年僅5%，如今升至28%，公司目標2029年衝到66%，屆時HPC客戶數佔整體客戶逾半，營收貢獻也將遠超一半。

盧美貞指出，AI加速器、伺服器CPU、GPU及相關先進節點需求，是代工訂單重心，三星會把5奈米以下、GAA先進製程與先進封裝一併推向HPC客戶。

業界人士解讀，三星代工過去客戶集中於自有手機與部分外部移動晶片，先進製程良率與接單穩定性長期受關注，如今喊出2029年客戶4倍、HPC佔比66%，等於直接向台積電AI代工版圖搶單，後續關鍵在2奈米GAA量產時程、SF2/SF3系良率、多客戶tape-out數量，以及HBM、CXL、先進封裝協同接單能力。若客戶多元化達標，三星代工可望降低對手機周期依賴；若先進製程良率與產能利用率落後，HPC佔比目標仍可能面臨下修壓力。

news.Title: 美股下挫+國際油價飆！台塑化逆勢狂噴9% 創波段新高
news.Content:
受美伊談判停滯、美股4大指數下跌及殖利率飆漲影響，台股今（29）日早盤一度下跌151點，不過台塑四寶則逆勢上漲，受國際油價上漲激勵的台塑化大漲逾9%，來到95.5元波段高點，台化一度上漲逾5%，台塑也有逾5%的漲幅。

在美伊衝突持續升溫的影響下，全球原油呈現結構性緊缺，台塑化受惠於國際油價上漲及煉油產品價差擴大，8月營收達819.06億元，月增9.5%，年增50.3%。

根據《經濟日報》報導，台塑化9月煉油廠煉量為每日50.8萬桶，產能利用率可達94%，預計第3季平均產能利用率91%、煉油利差有望創高；台塑化表示，預估汽、柴油價格將維持強勢，預期全年獲利表現樂觀，有望Q4持續交出亮眼成績單。

台塑化早盤以90元開出，一度大漲來到95.5元，後續來到94.7元附近震盪，漲幅逾8%，成交量來到2.2萬張；其餘台塑三寶也受激勵，台塑一度來到67.7元，上漲逾4%，台化來到71.4元，上漲逾5%，南亞則來到244元，上漲逾2%。

news.Title: 台股補跌至少千點？郭哲榮認「有可能」 最大痛點曝光
news.Content:
中秋節連假期間，受美債殖利率、油價走高影響，美股四大指數周一全面收黑，台股29日連假後第一個交易日，開盤就面臨「補跌」壓力， 早盤跌逾230點，最低來到4萬7786點，不僅4萬8千點失守，還跌4萬7800點關卡；摩爾投顧投資長郭哲榮指出，中秋連假韓國股市跌幅2.4％，台股今有補跌壓力，從韓股跌幅來看，指數今最多跌個1000點內都是有可能的。

不過，郭哲榮表示，台灣跌勢是短暫的，雖然美國總統川普嘴巴硬，但他認為，美國期中選舉在即，1個月內美伊就會簽和平協約，待荷姆茲海峽正式開放，「1個月內台灣股市會噴出去」，今年底前台股會衝破5萬點。

受美股四大指數收黑影響，亞股29日早盤表現也疲軟，韓股早盤KOSPI跌0.24％，日經指數則是開高走低，下跌逾700點，跌幅超過1.06％。

雖然台股遭逢補跌壓力，也年息率16％魅力、採月月配的主動式台股ETF主動中信台灣收益（00406A）今早盤就炸出逾32萬張的成交量，為台股熱門ETF排行榜單上最熱門的標的；據了解，近日公告最新一次除息交易日為10月5日，每單位擬配0.138元，以前一交易日收盤價計算，年化配息率高達16％。

安聯台灣大壩基金經理人蕭惠中表示，台股雖短線震盪，但中長線來看，AI供應鏈獲利成長、新平台產品放量、輝達訂單能見度延伸，以及市場風險偏好回升等利多因素，預料將持續發酵。整體行情有機會由先前的輪動整理，逐步演變為多頭擴散格局，第4季表現仍值得期待。

中秋連假期美股表現疲軟，美國總統川普拒絕伊朗提出的七天停火提議，並考慮在11月期中選舉之後恢復空襲伊朗，消息帶動國際油價28日急速飆高，漲幅一度超過4％，布蘭特原油升破每桶108美元。油價與美債殖利率持續走升，壓抑美股表現。台北股市今天開盤跌150點，加權股價指數為47873點，權值股台積電撐盤，台積電最多漲15元至2490元，指數幾度翻紅力守48000點之上。

news.Title: Meta Hasn't Split Its Stock Since Its IPO. Would a Stock Split Get It Into the Dow?
news.Content:
One share of Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) costs about $721 as of this writing.

No other Magnificent Seven stock comes close. Meta's shares cost around 40% more than those of Microsoft , the next-priced member of the group, and over three times as much as Nvidia's .

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Meta is also the only one in the group that hasn't split its stock since it went public in 2012, even while shares rose to a record close of $790 in August 2025.

This might leave some investors wondering if a split is next, especially because Amazon and Nvidia both split their shares before joining the price-weighted Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJINDICES:^DJI).

But Meta hasn't said anything to signal a split is coming. And I think the Dow case for one is weaker than it looks.

Image source: The Motley Fool.

Would a split change anything?

Not what the company is worth. A split just slices every share into more pieces.

A 10-for-1 split at today's price would turn one $721 share into 10 shares worth around $72 apiece. Meta's second-quarter earnings per share of $6.18 would become about $0.62, and the stock would still trade at about 21 times forward earnings .

Companies often frame splits as a way to make shares easier to own. Nvidia said its 2024 split was meant to make stock ownership more accessible to employees and investors.

The closest Meta has come was a 2016 plan, approved by shareholders, to pay a dividend of two new nonvoting Class C shares for every existing share. This would have tripled the share count, much as a 3-for-1 split does. But the board scrapped the plan in September 2017.

Price isn't what's keeping Meta out of the Dow

The Dow is price-weighted, so a company's impact on the index hinges on its share price rather than its size. After all, a 1% move in a $900 stock shifts the index as much as a 10% move in a $90 stock. So it's no wonder that high-priced tech stocks have often split before joining.

Amazon's shares closed at $2,785.58 the day it announced a 20-for-1 split in March 2022, and the company joined the Dow in February 2024. Nvidia closed at $949.50 the day it announced its 10-for-1 split in May 2024, and it joined that November. Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL), which split its stock 20-for-1 in 2022, followed in June of this year.

Story Continues

But Meta's share price isn't out of line with the Dow today. Goldman Sachs trades at around $917 and Caterpillar at about $812, and both are already Dow members.

By my math, Meta at today's price would make up about 8% of the index if it replaced the lowest-priced member -- the third-largest weight, after those two. A 10-for-1 split, though, would probably lower Meta's weight to below 1%.

Sure, a weight that small can be an issue too. When the index provider, S&P Dow Jones Indices, dropped Verizon Communications in June, it noted that Verizon made up only around half a percentage point of the index because of its low stock price.

Alphabet might have taken Meta's seat

The bigger hurdle is probably that the Dow just filled the slot Meta would most naturally take. When it added Alphabet to replace Verizon, S&P Dow Jones Indices said Alphabet would make a more representative communication services member of the index. Meta is in the same sector.

With Alphabet joining Nvidia, Amazon, Apple , and Microsoft in the index, Meta and Tesla are now the only Magnificent Seven stocks left out.

Meanwhile, Meta's value still comes from its advertising business, where pricing has been getting stronger. Showing how much advertisers are willing to pay, Meta's average price per ad climbed 12% year over year in the second quarter. That matched the first quarter's rate and doubled the 6% gain Meta reported for the last three months of 2025. Ad impressions, however, grew 14% in the second quarter, down from 19% growth in the previous quarter. So more of the growth is now coming from pricing. Together, the two raised second-quarter revenue 28% year over year to $60.8 billion.

Is Meta likely to split its stock soon?

I doubt it, and I don't think the Dow is a strong reason for one. At around 21 times forward earnings, the stock looks reasonably priced to me for a company growing so fast. A split wouldn't change that valuation.

news.Title: Meta’s AI ambitions put BlackRock’s prediction under spotlight
news.Content:
Meta Platforms (Nasdaq: META) co-founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced on Sep. 28 that the tech giant is starting a new business called Meta Enterprise Platform, focused on selling artificial intelligence (AI) tools to enterprise customers.

Zuckerberg said the initial focus is on bringing the full tech stack, including the Muse agent, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code, etc., to customers.

Related: Mark Zuckerberg eyes another billion-dollar market

Muse is Meta's AI agent designed to execute multi-step tasks across the internet and apps on the user's behalf.

It can answer questions, complete tasks, browse the web , make purchases, generate images, create documents, set reminders, and track goals, Meta said.

Popular on TheStreet Roundtable:

Vitalik Buterin makes a bold claim about Ethereum's future

California governor signs 'Opposite of Trump' bill

Coinbase CEO says his $400K Bitcoin target isn't guaranteed

BlackRock predicts rise in stablecoin usage when AI agents go shopping

Meta's latest business announcement comes only days after BlackRock made a major prediction last week.

The Wall Street giant published a report titled " The Machine-Native Economy" in which it predicted that the rise of agentic AI could become an "underappreciated source of demand, utility, and application growth" for digital assets.

As AI agents begin transacting independently, they will need payment systems designed for machines rather than humans, the asset manager said.

"Agentic commerce requires machine-native payment rails," BlackRock wrote, saying stablecoins , native cryptocurrencies, and other onchain assets could be used for payments and settlement.

Unlike volatile cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin (BTC), a stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that tries to stabilize its value by being pegged to a relatively stable asset.

Stablecoins pegged 1:1 to the U.S. dollar, such as USDT and USDC, have become extremely popular. Also called "digital dollars," these stablecoins make dollar transfers faster and cheaper.

BlackRock cited the Bitcoin Policy Institute's simulations that AI models generally favored stablecoins for everyday payments and Bitcoin for long-term value preservation. But it cautioned that the findings reflected simulated responses rather than actual agent behavior.

Related: Explained: What is a stablecoin?

news.Title: 台股Q4旺季要來了！20年歷史報酬率曝光　「主動ETF新兵」積極卡位千金、龍頭股
news.Content:
[ FTNN新聞網 ]財經中心／綜合報導

日前蘋果秋季發表會祭出品牌首款摺疊機，不僅吸引市場目光，也揭開消費電子旺季的序幕，過往經驗來看，第四季至隔年第一季為台股旺季，加權指數與電子指數表現亮眼，加上全球AI需求強勁，相關供應鏈股多點開花，因此在旺季效應與AI浪潮雙重推動下，9月底進場布局台股後市表現可期，而大型科技龍頭股與AI趨勢帶起的重點題材股更可說是台股投資必備，建議投資人可透過主動式市值型台股ETF來掌握行情，既有市值龍頭股的獲利底氣加持，也靈活掌握趨勢股與未來龍頭股的爆發力，力求超越大盤、創造超額報酬。

財富管理專家表示，近年來台股得益於AI崛起而表現強勢，市值型台股ETF也成為投資大眾用以參與台股成長的工具，不過在市場資金輪動快速之下，台股強勢次產業亦時有更替，若能在市值投資策略中搭載主動選股概念，將更有助於掌握台股成長行情。近期由群益投信推出的進化版主動式市值ETF「主動群益核心50」（00415A）正能滿足投資人需求，選股涵蓋獲利能力強之權值龍頭股、受惠AI需求強勁的（準）千金股以及商機潛力卓著的未來龍頭股，全方位網羅台股核心動能。00415A預計在9月30日募集、10月20日掛牌，每股發行價格為10元。

00415A經理人許育誌表示，台股歷經AI浪潮後，股市結構已逐漸轉為具爆發力的科技成長型市場，隨著AI發展持續推升台廠獲利動能，台股走勢有望持續由獲利成長驅動。再者，隨著時序距離第四季不遠，過往台股也存在Q4~Q1之旺季效應，自Q4的消費旺季到隔年Q1的元月行情與紅包行情，統計自2000年以來加權指數於Q4平均報酬為4.21%、電子指數為4.64%，Q1則分為4.57%和5.79%，亦即在9月底、10月初布局台股，除持續緊跟AI科技行情，還能同步掌握旺季行情。在產業佈局方面，科技股仍是投資核心，包括晶圓代工、PCB/CCL、ABF、半導體測試、IC設計、網通等值得持續留意。

news.Title: MongoDB stock crashes 26% as its CEO jumps ship
news.Content:
Every app on your phone has memory. Whether you save a playlist, pay a bill, or ask a chatbot a follow-up question, that information has to land somewhere it can be found again in a split second.

MongoDB Inc. (MDB) sells that memory. Its document database helps companies build applications faster, and its free Community Server has topped 500 million downloads since 2009. That reach matters because every new AI app needs a place to store its data.

On Monday, Sept. 28, 2026, the company that helps businesses hold on to everything lost the one asset it could not back up.

CEO Chirantan "CJ" Desai stepped down, effective immediately, to pursue a senior role at Meta Platforms (META), according to Reuters . He had held the job for less than a year, CNBC reported.

The market did not wait for an explanation. MongoDB shares crashed more than 26% in early trading, according to Seeking Alpha .

The opening gap erased roughly $8 billion in market value, based on CNN's opening price and Morningstar's share count. That is more than three times the $2.46 billion in revenue MongoDB booked last fiscal year, according to Stock Analysis .

Desai will run Meta Enterprise Platform, a new unit selling Meta's AI models, agents, and infrastructure to businesses, according to Bloomberg . In a Meta statement , he set the goal: to make Meta "the place enterprises come to scale their businesses."

That goal should worry MongoDB holders. The executive hired to chase enterprise AI spending for MongoDB will now chase it for a far richer company.

The board knew 4 days before investors did

The exit looked sudden from the outside. The paperwork tells a slower story. Desai told MongoDB he intended to resign on Thursday, Sept. 24, 2026, according to a securities filing . Directors named Dev Ittycheria interim CEO two days later.

Ittycheria ran MongoDB from 2014 to 2025 and grew annual revenue from about $35 million to more than $2.3 billion , according to a MongoDB press release .

Chairman Tom Killalea said Ittycheria "knows this company deeply," and MongoDB reaffirmed its third-quarter and full-year fiscal 2027 guidance.

Ittycheria pledged to "move quickly, execute with focus," yet the calendar works against him. MongoDB hosts its Investor Day on Tuesday, Sept. 29, 2026. Investors wanted an update to a long-term plan that still assumes high-teens growth, even though MongoDB reported 30% revenue growth last quarter.

Now an interim CEO will pitch a plan drawn up under the executive who just left. That is a hard story to sell in one afternoon.

Story Continues

MongoDB stock now trades far below analyst targets

Before the drop, the stock traded at about 12 times sales. That leaves little room for surprises.

MDB Shares closed at $410.44 on Friday, Sept. 25, 2026.

The stock opened at $310.94 on Monday, Sept. 28, 2026, a $99.50 gap below that close.

The 52-week range runs from $215.68 to $473.10 , which puts the opening price closer to the low than the high.

The average rating from 41 analysts is Buy , with a 12-month price target of $456.88 , according to Stock Analysis . That target sits about 47% above the opening price.

That gap is the story. Analysts are valuing a business that posted 30% revenue growth, while the market is pricing a company without a permanent leader. Needham called the timing "unfortunate" but stressed that MongoDB is running efficiently, according to TipRanks .

The pattern is familiar. Shares fell 13.5% on Wednesday, Sept. 2, 2026, after its Atlas cloud database grew 28.9% , below investor hopes of roughly 30% , despite a revenue beat. MongoDB keeps getting punished for doubt, not for weak results.

More MongoDB:

MongoDB investors have one number to watch

MongoDB missed one number and investors punished the stock

Piper Sandler names 5 software stocks cutting AI token costs

MongoDB shareholders paid for Meta's latest hire

MongoDB tried to lock Desai in. His November 2025 offer included $32.5 million in stock awards, more than half tied to share-price targets through 2030, according to a 2025 filing . The filing also said the second half of his $2.5 million signing bonus was due after 12 months. He left about six weeks short.

The lesson for boards is uncomfortable. A pay package built to fend off rival software companies means little when the recruiter has Meta's balance sheet.

Meta has done this before. In 2025, it paid $14.3 billion for 49% of Scale AI and hired its CEO, Alexandr Wang, according to Fortune . Scale walked away with Meta's money. MongoDB's shareholders were left with the bill.

For investors, the fallout reaches beyond one database stock. As AI giants hunt for executives who can sell to corporations, a software CEO is now a recruiting target.

Key-person risk usually reads like boilerplate. At MongoDB, it just came with an $8 billion price tag.

Related: MongoDB missed one number and investors punished the stock

news.Title: Can Cloudflare (NET) Become the Gatekeeper of the AI Web?
news.Content:
On September 15, Cloudflare, Inc. (NYSE: NET ) announced its new Accountable designation for AI crawling alongside the launch of "Disallow AI Training." This tool allows website owners to block AI models from scraping their content for training purposes while remaining fully indexable in traditional search results.

Addressing the dilemma where publishers were forced to choose between search visibility and protecting intellectual property, Cloudflare established compliance criteria for crawler operators. Major tech players including Apple, Google, and Microsoft have achieved or committed to the Accountable framework. Mixed-use crawlers failing to comply face network-level blocks if a site owner enables the training block.

You May Also Want To Read: Jim Cramer Calls Akamai (AKAM) "Terrific" and Cloudflare (NET) One of His Favorites

Bull Case: Solidifying Causal Dominance in the AI Economy

This governance release directly advances Cloudflare, Inc. (NYSE:NET)'s position at the center of machine-to-machine traffic and the "Agentic Internet," establishing its platform as an essential policy enforcement layer for web content. Positioning itself as the gatekeeper of AI data access expands Cloudflare's platform value, supporting customer acquisition and deepening cross-selling opportunities across security and edge developer suites.

This expanding moat is backed by robust financial momentum. In Q2 2026, Cloudflare reported total revenue of $696.1 million (up 36% year-over-year) and delivered a 120% net retention rate, demonstrating sustained account expansion. Operating cash flow reached $117.6 million, generating $56.4 million in free cash flow (8% of revenue). With $4.16 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and available-for-sale securities, Cloudflare possesses substantial liquidity to build out AI infrastructure, monetize agent-driven traffic, and fund developer tools without needing external capital. Management projects continuous acceleration, targeting Q3 2026 revenue between $736 million and $737 million, and full-year 2026 revenue of $2.864 billion to $2.870 billion.

Bear Case: Structural Cost Pressures and Unresolved GAAP Losses

While policy control enhances network utility, enforceability depends on crawler compliance and constant network overhead, exposing Cloudflare to underlying cost and operational pressures. Network scale expansion continues to compress margins: Q2 2026 GAAP gross margin slipped to 71.8% (down from 74.9% in Q2 2025), and non-GAAP gross margin dropped to 73.1% (from 76.3% prior).

Story Continues

Moreover, revenue growth has not resolved bottom-line profitability. Cloudflare recorded a GAAP operating loss of $205.7 million (29.6% of revenue) in Q2 2026, more than triple its $67.3 million loss from Q2 2025. Total GAAP net loss expanded to $170.0 million ($0.48 per share). Non-GAAP operating income was $96.1 million (13.8% of revenue), but the widening GAAP operating deficit reflects heavy stock-based compensation, capital expenditures, and ongoing operational costs. If AI traffic management accelerates bandwidth delivery demands without immediate incremental monetization, rising infrastructure costs could further delay the path toward GAAP break-even.

Don't Miss: Cloudflare (NET) Soars 10.5% on Upbeat Outlook, Says Opportunities 'Larger' Than Business

Conclusion

Cloudflare, Inc. (NYSE:NET)'s Accountable designation positions the company as a critical intermediary in AI content governance. While top-line growth (+36% YoY) and strong cash balances ($4.16B) validate market leadership, investors must weigh this ecosystem expansion against persistent GAAP losses and gross margin compression.

While we acknowledge the potential of NET as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: 統一證券：台股技術面維持穩健強勢
news.Content:
【昨日盤勢】：

受到美10年國債殖利率創下2007年7月以來新高，加上美伊談判喬不攏油價上漲等利空，拖累上週四台股開低震盪，盤中一度失守五日線，所幸一點過後，聯發科及台塑集團低接買盤拉抬，收盤守穩5日線之上。CCL族群因AI伺服器、HPC需求持續升溫，受到資金青睞相關個股表現強勢。除此之外，磊晶及不銹鋼族群同樣表現亮眼。權值股方面，台積電下跌1.00%、鴻海下跌2.15%、聯發科上漲1.93%、廣達下跌0.88%，台達電上漲0.53%。盤面強勢股，聯茂、騰輝電子-KY、嘉晶、彰源、雷科、晶心科、中釉等共23檔個股漲停；亞泰金屬、M31、健策、佰鴻、陽程、雙鴻等漲幅7%以上。盤面弱勢股，和益、巨虹等跌停；禾榮科、精拓科、台灣精材、鴻勁、精材、建達、精測等跌幅4%以上。終場台灣加權指數下跌132.69點，以48024.60點作收，成交量7366.24億元。三大類股漲跌互見，電子下跌0.30%、傳產上漲0.34%、金融下跌0.85%。在次族群部份以塑膠、玻璃陶瓷、電子零組件表現較佳，分別上漲3.60%、1.61%、1.15%。

【資金動向】：

三大法人合計賣超444.49億元。其中外資賣超329.65億元，投信賣超128.23億元，自營商買超13.38億元。外資買超前五大為合晶、南亞、南茂、嘉晶、緯創；賣超前五大為友達、力積電、聯電、鴻海、南亞科。投信買超前五大為華航、長榮航、玉山金、昇陽半導體、永豐金；賣超前五大為聯電、欣銓、南亞、南亞科、日月光投控。資券變化方面，融資增87.36億元，融資餘額為6151.03億元，融券減1.11萬張，融券餘額為20.2萬張。外資台指期部位，空單增加909口，淨空單部位77031口，借券賣出金額300.21億元。成交比重：電子88.58%、傳產9.71%、金融1.71%。

【今日盤勢分析】：

川普拒絕伊朗重開荷姆茲海峽談判，儘管盤中傳出美方可能在伊朗核問題取得「具體進展」後放寬制裁，但未能扭轉油價上漲走勢。除此之外，債市賣壓則未緩解，10年期美債殖利率週一收於5.241%，連續第五個交易日走高，為2007 年 6/12以來最高收盤水準，連帶拖累美股。週一美股四大指數全面下跌，台積電ADR逆勢上漲0.50%。輝達宣布將庫藏股計畫規模增加1,500億美元，創史上最高庫藏股追加規模，推動輝達股價逆勢收紅。台股後市分析如下：

第一、台股8月狂飆3,009點，寫史上最強8月，散戶信心大幅回溫，中央銀行23日公布公布8月金融情況，市場關注的「散戶風向球」證券劃撥存款餘額如市場預期反彈，且大增3,889億元之多，月增創史上新高，推升餘額衝上4兆5,712億元，同創歷史新高，另股市融資餘額暴增逾800億元為今年次高。

news.Title: Is Shopify (SHOP)’s AI Opportunity Bigger Than it Looks?
news.Content:
On September 23, Mizuho reiterated an Outperform rating and $180 price target on Shopify Inc. (NASDAQ: SHOP ), viewing a recent stock pullback as a compelling buying opportunity. The weakness occurred after reports surfaced that Meta Platforms is planning a Meta Pay wallet for its new Muse AI assistant, causing investors to fear potential disintermediation. However, Mizuho highlighted that this market reaction mirrors the overdone concerns seen during Stripe Link's introduction two weeks prior.

The firm clarified that consumer-facing payment wallets, whether Meta Pay, Stripe Link, or Shop Pay, simply serve as front-end user interfaces. Crucially, Shopify Payments remains the underlying merchant-side processing infrastructure that handles transactions and captures take rates. Management confirmed there is no change to payment economics, making Muse adoption a net positive tailwind for Shopify's volume.

You May Also Want To Read: Shopify's Tailwind Acquisition Feeds the Agentic Commerce Story, But the Market Is Already Nervous About the Bill

Bull Case

Shopify Inc. (NASDAQ:SHOP)'s core fundamental trajectory remains exceptionally robust, as reflected in its Q2 2026 financial results. The company delivered broad-based performance, achieving 34% year-over-year revenue growth (33% in constant currency) alongside an 18% free cash flow margin. Growth was balanced across merchant sizes, sales channels, and geographies rather than concentrated in a single product. Expanding payments scale and deeper adoption of Shop Pay deepen Shopify's platform relevance, capturing a larger share of global commerce gross merchandise volume (GMV).

Looking ahead to Q3 2026, management expects low-thirties revenue growth and mid-to-high twenties gross profit growth, reinforced by free cash flow margins in the high-teens to low-twenties. This elite balance sheet and cash generation capability grant Shopify immense flexibility to invest in emerging distribution channels like agentic AI commerce without relying on external capital.

Bear Case

Despite strong top-line momentum, bears point to potential margin dilution arising from unfavorable gross profit mix shifts. In Q2 2026, faster-growing Merchant Solutions naturally compressed gross margin profiles relative to high-margin Subscription Solutions, requiring continued operational leverage to convert sales growth into sustained bottom-line expansion. Additionally, Shopify's growing credit and capital products introduce incremental risk exposure, as underwritten capital losses could rise during macroeconomic volatility.

Story Continues

Investors must also weigh Shopify's history of profitability divergence between operating and net income metrics. To justify premium valuation multiples, Shopify must maintain strict expense discipline, targeting Q3 2026 operating expenses at 33% to 34% of revenue, and prove that core commerce margins can remain durable through changing economic cycles.

Don't Miss: Shopify Opens Its Doors to Muse, Here's Why Amazon Won't

Conclusion

The market's initial selling reaction to Meta Pay in Muse overlooks Shopify's structural role in digital commerce. Because front-end wallet integrations do not bypass Shopify Payments' merchant-side processing, expanding third-party AI interfaces will likely act as volume accelerators rather than margin headwinds. Supported by 34% Q2 revenue growth, expanding free cash flow, and a solid Q3 outlook, Shopify Inc. (NASDAQ:SHOP)'s underlying fundamental engine remains fully intact, validating Mizuho's view that recent pullbacks offer an attractive entry point for long-term investors.

While we acknowledge the potential of SHOP as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. AMD just spent $8.2 billion to enlist the 'Godmother of AI'
news.Content:
In spending $8.2 billion to scoop up World Labs, AMD ( AMD ) CEO Lisa Su has gained an AI innovator and possible successor for when the time comes.

AMD announced late this afternoon an agreement to acquire World Labs , an AI model lab based in San Francisco that focuses on software for 3D environments.

The transaction is expected to close by the end of 2026.

World Labs was founded in 2024 and is led by Dr. Fei-Fei Li, a leading AI researcher known in tech circles as the "Godmother of AI." She was once the chief scientist at Google ( GOOG ) Cloud.

Li will join AMD as an executive vice president and chief scientist. The direct reporting line to Su underscores the pivotal role Li will play in shaping AMD amid the unprecedented AI boom.

At the same time, Li will add new operational layers to her resume by working closely with one of the most well-regarded CEOs in tech , including a greater presence on Wall Street and executing big deals like the one Su struck with Meta ( META ) this year.

AMD shares rose slightly in after-hours trading.

"This is a talent and model-insight buy, not a revenue play. AMD gets the people building the models its future chips will have to run. Fei-Fei made the case from her side: 'Without having a focused hardware effort, AI is hobbled in efficiency,'" tech analyst Patrick Moorhead said.

Citigroup analyst Atif Malik also shared an initial reaction to AMD's latest bout of dealmaking.

"By adding Dr. Fei-Fei Li and her team, AMD gains deeper visibility into how AI models are evolving, which strengthens its competitive position against NVIDIA and accelerates its broader AI platform ambitions," Malik wrote. "We believe the motivations for this transaction include: 1) acquiring more leading AI engineers; 2) better position the company within physical AI, and 3) build better end-to-end systems. We maintain AMD as our favorite growth compute semis pick in 2026."

news.Title: Meta Platforms (META): Are You Going to Buy the Promise?
news.Content:
The promise is what Meta Platforms, Inc. (NASDAQ: META ) can do with AI and the reward for investors. But the cost associated with the AI ambitions is steep, even for a company with deep pockets.

But no pain, no gain. We've all heard that.

Meta's capital expenditures shot up to $31.1 billion in Q2, from $19.4 billion in the same quarter last year. The company generated only $784 million in free cash flow in the latest quarter, down sharply from $10.6 billion a year ago.

All that is happening because of soaring AI infrastructure costs. Meta expects to spend up to $145 billion on capex in 2026, primarily on infrastructure buildout. That heavy spending combined with uncertainty over how quickly products such as Muse can generate material revenue has some investors on edge.

Copyright: antonioguillem / 123RF Stock Photo

For a deeper look at how Meta's Muse could translate its massive user base into a meaningful new revenue stream, see: Meta's (META) Muse Math: 10 Million Paying Users Could Mean $2.4 Billion a Year

Competition is another cause for concern about whether Meta's AI investments can produce justifiable returns. In the race to build and monetize AI products, Meta is up against many technology giants. And beyond direct competition for AI customers, there are turf skirmishes that could slow down monetization progress. For instance, Amazon reportedly blocked Muse AI assistant from shopping on its retail site.

The concerns are obviously legitimate. But focusing exclusively on them risks overlooking the larger opportunity.

AI Is Already Working for Meta and the Future Awaits

For Meta Platforms, Inc. (NASDAQ:META)'s AI ambitions, there's proof today and optionality tomorrow.

The proof today is visible in Meta's advertising business. Meta has been using AI to improve recommendations, targeting, and conversion performance. In Q2, advertising revenue jumped more than 27% to around $59.4 billion. Ad impressions increased 14%, while average price per ad rose 12%.

That matters because Meta is not relying only on future AI products to recover its AI investments. Meta has demonstrated that AI can improve the economics of the flagship advertising business that built the company. Advertising remains Meta's bread and butter, contributing about 98% of overall revenue.

The opportunity could then expand beyond advertising. Meta has introduced Meta One, a subscription service offering additional AI capabilities for creators and businesses. More than one million businesses were using Meta business agents weekly to respond to customers on WhatsApp and Messenger in Q2. Those agents could generate revenue through subscriptions and performance-based models. Muse and AI glasses provide another optionality.

Story Continues

Meta's massive user base gives it an unusual advantage. The company has over 3.6 billion daily active people across its family of apps. That provides a huge potential market for Meta's AI products.

Nothing is Flawless

The bull case weakens if AI spending grows faster than the benefits it produces. Also, widespread adoption of AI products doesn't guarantee stronger margins. At the same time, intensifying competition could increase Meta's development costs or prevent it from establishing a dominant market position.

Meta Retains Strong Hedge Fund Backing, Shorts Question Their Bets

At the end of Q2, 254 hedge funds held Meta Platforms, Inc. (NASDAQ:META), compared to 262 in Q1. Some major funds raised their stakes in the latest quarter, including D.E. Shaw, which pushed its position up 81%. Short interest increased slightly to 1.4% from 1.3% in the previous reading.

Meta's AI spending does not need to produce an immediate standalone AI business to generate shareholder value. AI can simultaneously sharpen Meta's existing advertising business and open new revenue streams. The question is whether those benefits can compound fast enough to justify the heavy spending.

While we acknowledge the potential of META as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: 1 Monster AI Stock Greg Abel and Warren Buffett Are Extremely Bullish On
news.Content:
Warren Buffett, who recently stepped down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway , doesn't have a history of owning technology businesses. While the conglomerate's investment in Apple can be viewed as a bet on a strong consumer brand, the Omaha company's sizable bet on Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOGL) (NASDAQ: GOOG) signals an evolution.

The legendary investor and his successor, Greg Abel, are extremely bullish on this monster artificial intelligence (AI) stock .

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

It came as a surprise when it was revealed in July that Warren Buffett was the one who initiated Berkshire Hathaway's first purchase of Alphabet shares in the third quarter of 2025. He clearly understands how dominant a business the internet giant is, with widely adopted and irreplaceable platforms, network effects, first-rate technical expertise, and sizable profits.

Berkshire Hathaway added to its stake in 2026. And as of Sept. 25, Alphabet makes up 10% of its entire portfolio. Between Class A and Class C shares, this business is its third-largest holding.

Abel and Buffett are clearly bullish on the leading AI enterprise, which currently trades at a reasonable 22.8 times consensus earnings estimates. They are showcasing their confidence in Alphabet at a time when it has raised tremendous amounts of capital to invest aggressively in the development of data centers.

The two executives must have a firm belief that the company will generate satisfactory returns on its massive capital expenditures . Time will tell if this is the right call.

news.Title: Nokia (NOK) and Microsoft (MSFT) are Expanding Their AI Reach. Can the Opportunity Translate into Returns?
news.Content:
It was reported on September 17 that Nokia Oyj (NYSE: NOK ) is extending its partnership with Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ: MSFT ) to build an agentic, unified data foundation combining Nokia Data Suite with Microsoft Fabric to enable AI-driven telecommunications network operations. The collaboration integrates network data products with Microsoft's cloud analytics and AI capabilities, allowing operators to access structured network data in minutes rather than weeks. The solution is currently available and builds on existing agreements across cloud infrastructure, security, and AI workloads.

You May Also Want To Read: Microsoft (MSFT) Puts GitHub's Coding Engine Inside the App Office Workers Already Use

drserg / Shutterstock.com

Bull Case: Strategic AI Scale and Network Expansion

For Nokia Oyj (NYSE:NOK), linking its telco data assets with Microsoft Fabric accelerates monetization within its fast-growing AI & Cloud segment, where order intake reached €2.8 billion in Q2 2026 and net sales to AI & Cloud customers surged 105% year-over-year. This software integration leverages momentum in Nokia's Network Infrastructure division, which grew 12% in constant currency during Q2, without demanding incremental physical manufacturing capacity. Supported by €2.78 billion in net cash, Nokia can easily fund joint go-to-market activities while improving enterprise software margins.

For Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT), integrating telco network data directly into Fabric strengthens Azure's enterprise ecosystem, supporting Azure's 43% revenue growth in Q4 FY26 and expanding Microsoft Cloud revenue beyond its $59.3 billion quarterly base. Unlocking automated network workloads deepens Azure's presence among telecommunications operators, reinforcing Microsoft's recurring cloud and AI subscriptions with minimal added capital overhead.

Bear Case: Restructuring Drag and Infrastructure Capital Costs

For Nokia, software partnerships do not fully offset ongoing operational headwinds and margin pressure. Despite comparable operating margin expansion to 9.0%, reported operating margin fell to (1.0)% in Q2 2026 due to accelerated restructuring expenses, while net cash declined 4% year-over-year to €2.78 billion. If carrier enterprise adoption stutters, software revenue may fail to offset near-term cash burn and working-capital constraints.

For Microsoft, driving agentic AI operations across telecommunication networks demands massive data center capacity, compounding its capital expenditure load. While FY26 total revenue reached $331.8 billion, heavy AI infrastructure investments continue to weigh on free cash flow generation and depress consolidated gross margins compared to legacy software lines. Furthermore, ongoing pressure in More Personal Computing, where Windows OEM and Devices revenue fell 7% and Xbox content dropped 10% in Q4, leaves Microsoft reliant on continuous cloud acceleration to justify its elevated AI capital deployment.

Story Continues

Don't Miss: Azure's Inflection Point: Can Microsoft (MSFT) Balance AI Growth With Capex Risk?

Conclusion and Market Sentiment

The extended partnership offers clear strategic catalysts for both companies, though market sentiment remains more conditionally favorable toward Microsoft given its operational scale ($40.6 billion in Q4 operating income) and $678 billion commercial remaining performance obligation. Nokia Oyj (NYSE:NOK) secures an immediate path to monetize its telco data, but investor upside hinges on translating its €2.1–€2.6 billion FY26 operating profit target into positive free cash flow. news.Title: Arm vs. Marvell Technology: Which AI Chip Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
news.Content:
Arm Holdings (NASDAQ:ARM) and Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) both sell into the AI data center boom, but they make money in very different ways.

Arm provides the architectural blueprints for the energy-efficient processors found in nearly every smartphone and a growing number of data centers. Marvell specializes in high-speed networking and custom silicon for moving and processing data within the cloud. Investors have rewarded both, with Marvell shares more than tripling over the past year and Arm's more than doubling.

The case for Arm

Arm licenses its intellectual property to semiconductor companies and earns royalties on chips that use its designs. The company says it has held more than 99% of the smartphone application processor market for years, and it's pushing further into data centers, where its royalties more than doubled year over year in its fiscal first quarter.

In fiscal 2026, which ended March 31, 2026, revenue rose 22.8% to $4.92 billion. Net income came to $904 million, up from $792 million in fiscal 2025. Growth held at 22% in the June quarter, and management guided for revenue of $1.38 billion, plus or minus $50 million, in the September quarter.

Arm carried no debt beyond lease obligations at the end of fiscal 2026, and its current ratio was about 6.0, meaning current assets covered short-term obligations six times over. Free cash flow, which is operating cash flow minus capital expenditures, was about $979 million. Stock-based compensation equaled roughly 69% of operating cash flow. Because it's a noncash expense added back to the cash flow statement, it inflates reported cash generation.

The case for Marvell Technology

Marvell makes data infrastructure chips, including networking products and custom silicon for cloud companies. Its revenue is concentrated among a small group of buyers. Its 10 largest customers made up 82% of revenue in fiscal 2026, with one distributor accounting for 37% and one direct customer for 14%.

One of those relationships just got bigger. In July, Marvell signed an expanded agreement to develop custom chips that attach to Google's TPU ecosystem, and in August, it issued Google a warrant to buy up to 58,970,907 shares at $206.58 apiece. Nearly all of those shares vest only as Google's purchases add up, with one tranche vesting for each $500 million in custom product revenue through fiscal 2033.

Revenue climbed 42.1% to $8.19 billion in fiscal 2026, which ended Jan. 31, 2026. Marvell posted GAAP net income of $2.67 billion after net losses in each of the two prior years, although a $1.8 billion pre-tax gain on the sale of its automotive Ethernet business accounts for a large share of that profit. Momentum has picked up since. Revenue rose 37% to a record $2.74 billion in the second quarter of fiscal 2027, and management guided for about $3.15 billion in the third quarter, plus or minus 5%.

Story Continues

At the end of fiscal 2026, total debt equaled about 0.3 times shareholders' equity, and the current ratio was about 2.0. Free cash flow totaled about $1.4 billion, and stock-based compensation accounted for roughly 34% of operating cash flow.

Risk profile comparison

Arm faces competition from free, open-source alternatives like RISC-V, and the company notes that many of its customers support that architecture. Smartphones remain a large exposure, since mobile application processors produced about 43% of Arm's royalty revenue in fiscal 2026. SoftBank Group also owns about 86.4% of Arm, making it a controlled company and leaving outside shareholders with little say.

Marvell's customer concentration means the loss of a single large buyer could hit results hard. The majority of its products are made by third-party foundries in Taiwan, leaving it exposed to regional geopolitical tensions, and export controls have previously limited its sales to customers in China. The Google warrant could also dilute existing shareholders by roughly 6.7% of today's outstanding shares if it fully vests.

Valuation comparison

Marvell trades at less than half of Arm's multiples of both forward earnings and sales.

Which stock would I buy in 2026?

Marvell looks like the better buy to me, but I'd go in knowing that a small group of cloud customers can swing its results from one year to the next.

The case comes down to growth and price. Marvell's sales are rising faster than Arm's, and management expects that pace to accelerate through the rest of fiscal 2027 as its custom chip work ramps up. Yet its shares trade at less than half of Arm's multiple of forward earnings.

I'm comfortable with the Google warrant. It could dilute existing holders, but nearly all of those shares vest only if Google keeps buying custom chips from Marvell in very large quantities, so the dilution would accompany a lot of new revenue. Having Google tie its own upside to Marvell's success is a vote of confidence I'd take.

Arm is a terrific business. Its designs are found in nearly every smartphone, and data centers are becoming a second growth engine. The problem is the price. At more than 120 times forward earnings, the stock already assumes years of excellent execution, and SoftBank's majority stake leaves outside shareholders with little say in how the company is run.

For a patient investor who owns a diversified portfolio and plans to hold for years, Marvell offers more growth for the money. Its Investor Day on Oct. 6 should give a clearer look at how much of that growth management can see ahead.

news.Title: GLOBALFOUNDRIES (GFS) and Monolithic Power (MPWR) Are Scaling Up. Can the Growth Last?
news.Content:
On September 9, GLOBALFOUNDRIES Inc. (NASDAQ: GFS ) and Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ: MPWR ) announced a long-term manufacturing agreement to deploy MPS's proprietary process technology to GF's 300mm facility in Singapore. The partnership expands manufacturing capacity for critical power management solutions, targeting high-growth markets by early 2027. The agreement aligns with both companies' strategic priorities, though each faces distinct execution requirements.

You May Also Want To Read: Monolithic Power Revenue Jumped 48%. Can AI Power Chips Keep the Momentum Going?

Strategic Synergy and Bull Case

For Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:MPWR), the deal directly supports its plan to expand manufacturing capacity beyond $6 billion to meet surging demand. MPS reported record Q2 2026 revenue of $980.6 million, up 47.6% year-over-year, driven by its Enterprise Data segment, which surged 164.3% year-over-year to $380.6 million. Supported by $1.41 billion in cash and short-term investments, MPS can fund capacity expansion while maintaining non-GAAP gross margins of 55.6%. Outsourcing production to GF's Singapore fab diversifies MPS's global supply chain and supports new platform rollouts, including 800V data center architectures and high-speed DDR5 memory components.

For GLOBALFOUNDRIES Inc. (NASDAQ:GFS), capturing MPS's proprietary power management volume strengthens foundry utilization and reinforces its position in high-growth data center and automotive applications. The agreement complements GF's recent strategic moves, including the acquisition of Photeon Technologies' integrated voltage regulator business to expand its power delivery offerings. GF delivered strong Q2 2026 results with $1.786 billion in revenue and $3.3 billion in total liquidity, providing a strong foundation to absorb capacity investments. Secured multi-year commitments from high-margin design leaders like MPS strengthen GF's long-term revenue visibility.

Execution Risks and Bear Case

For Monolithic Power, relying on an external foundry for proprietary process technology introduces qualification and operational execution risks. Ramp-up delays or yield challenges at GF's Singapore facility prior to the 2027 target could constrain supply as MPS scales its broader solutions model. Furthermore, inventory rose to $675.8 million in Q2 2026; if customer adoption of new early-stage programs lags behind aggressive capacity additions, operating leverage could face temporary pressure.

For GlobalFoundries, high capital intensity remains a primary headwind. GF generated negative adjusted free cash flow of $(3) million in Q2 2026, reflecting the heavy capital expenditures required to support advanced fab lines. While the MPS partnership brings future volume, GF remains exposed to near-term headwinds in its broader end markets, particularly smart-mobile demand. Allocating advanced 300mm capacity to long-term agreements requires sustained capital deployment before generating meaningful cash flows.

Conclusion

The manufacturing agreement offers strategic benefits for both semiconductor players. Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:MPWR) secures the diversified scale required to sustain its enterprise data momentum, while GLOBALFOUNDRIES Inc. (NASDAQ:GFS) secures high-value manufacturing volume to enhance fab utilization. However, the transaction's ultimate financial return depends on seamless technology deployment in Singapore and timely customer absorption of new capacity by 2027.

Google highlighted that its Hamina site, part of a 43-region network, allows local entities like Nokia to deliver high-performance, low-latency services and scale AI solutions. Furthermore, Nokia enters this demand cycle backed by a resilient balance sheet. Despite ongoing restructuring investments, Nokia closed Q2 2026 with €2.8 billion in net cash and interest-bearing financial investments, providing a solid cushion to fund optical capacity expansions. This low-leverage position grants Nokia the operational flexibility to absorb short-term volatility while capturing long-term structural cloud growth.

Additionally, Nokia is carrying a heavy integration and organizational burden as it executes its strategy. Furthermore, management explicitly noted that supply remains the main industry constraint relative to strong demand. If hyperscaler demand from projects like Google's outpaces Nokia's internal Indium Phosphide component and delivery capacity before additional facilities scale up, supply constraints could limit top-line conversion and delay revenue realization.

Google's €13 billion Finland investment provides strong strategic validation for Nokia Oyj (NYSE:NOK)'s focus on the AI supercycle. While the news validates Nokia's double-digit Network Infrastructure growth and expanding AI order pipeline, realizing long-term shareholder value depends heavily on operational execution. Specifically, Meta introduced an AI amulet called the Muse Charm for its popular personal Muse AI agent. The device features microphones, speakers, cameras, and more, as well as a customizable virtual character called Jolly with options to personalize its appearance and voice. Basically, the Muse experience is being packed into a small gadget with an avatar communicating with the user.

With Muse Charm shipments expected to begin in December, let's take a closer look at what's going on with Meta Platforms and META stock.

About Meta Stock

Meta operates social media apps including Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Threads, while increasingly pivoting its strategy and capital toward artificial intelligence. Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, Meta is investing billions of dollars annually in AI infrastructure, data centers, and advanced models such as Llama and its Muse AI agent.

The shift has driven workforce reallocation, with thousands of employees moved into AI-focused units and hiring concentrated in AI research and infrastructure. Currently, the company commands a massive market capitalization of $1.9 trillion.

META stock is down about 4% over the past year because massive AI-driven revenue growth has been largely offset by surging costs, heavy capital spending, and investor concerns about the timing of returns on investment. However, the stock has gained 36% over the past six months. META stock reached a 52-week high of $779.82 on Sept. 24 and is only down 8% from that level.

Meta's 14-day RSI was in overbought territory after the stock skyrocketed following the Muse launch. Since then, however, the 14-day RSI has fallen down to around 60. Considering its growth, META stock also still trades cheap, with its PEG ratio of 1.3 times in-line with the industry average.

Story Continues

Meta Reports Q2 Earnings

For the second quarter of fiscal 2026, revenue climbed 28% year-over-year (YOY) to $60.8 billion. Revenue was driven largely by the company's Family of Apps segment, which saw sales increase 28% to $60.37 billion. Ad impressions across Meta's app family rose 14% YOY in Q2, while average price per ad rose 12% YOY.

However, surging expenses pressured profitability. Meta's costs and expenses jumped 55% YOY to $42.03 billion, while capital expenditures reached $31.08 billion as the company accelerated AI investment. As a result, quarterly EPS fell 13% to $6.18 per share.

Wall Street analysts have mixed feelings about Meta's future earnings. For the current fiscal year, EPS is projected to decrease 6% YOY to $27.93, then grow 23% to $34.36 in the next fiscal year. Moreover, analysts expect EPS to decline 12% YOY to $6.39 in the current quarter.

Strong AI momentum has led Wall Street analysts to reiterate their bullish stances on META stock. Recently, JP Morgan analyst Doug Anmuth maintained an "Overweight" rating on Meta Platforms stock and raised the price target from $820 to $920.

Tigress Financial also recently raised its price target on META stock from $945 to $995 while maintaining a "Strong Buy" rating. The firm described the Muse launch as a paradigm shift that could convert Meta's global network into a personal AI platform. Analyst Ivan Feinseth believes Meta now has multiple new avenues for AI investment monetization.

Finally, analysts at RBC Capital kept an "Outperform" rating on Meta with a $770 price target. RBC highlighted management's announcement of several major retail partners for Muse.

Meta has been in the spotlight on Wall Street, with analysts awarding it a consensus "Strong Buy" rating. Of the 54 analysts rating the stock, 45 analysts have a "Strong Buy," two analysts suggest a "Moderate Buy" rating, and seven analysts have a "Hold" rating. The average price target of $794.24 represents potential upside of 11% from current levels, while the Street-high price target of $1,000 suggests shares could rise as much as 40% from here.

news.Title: Former Microsoft strategy chief explains why most digital ads 'are not very good' — and how AI will help
news.Content:
Most internet ads are ineffective, Stagwell ( STGW ) CEO Mark Penn is quick to point out, and AI could make them better.

"Most digital ads are not very good," Penn, formerly chief strategy officer at Microsoft ( MSFT ), told Power Players with Brian Sozzi (video above). "You run through hundreds and hundreds of those in a day, and they have virtually no impact on you, by and large."

Stagwell provides creative, technology, media, and research services to major brands and organizations. Penn, who said he was "really co-CMO" at Microsoft at one point, explained that the potential payoff from AI isn't doing the old work more cheaply.

"People always make the mistake of thinking that new technology is about simplifying the stuff we used to do," he said. "New technology is about doing things we always wished we could do, but couldn't do in the past."

AI is "revolutionizing production," Penn said, and the bar for advertisers goes up with it.

"There's more of a premium now on getting the right ad to the right person at the right time with something that is ... really interesting and engaging," he said.

Asked whether AI would crush the ad industry, Penn said, "AI is more, much more of our friend, actually."

He explained that Stagwell has created "a series of products we call the machine," and demand is up: "We have more people looking for premium creative ... and more people looking for digital transformation than ever."

news.Title: Broadcom vs. Marvell Technology: Which Semiconductor Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
news.Content:
The artificial intelligence revolution has turned the semiconductor market into a high-stakes arena for investors. Choosing between Broadcom (NASDAQ:AVGO) and Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) requires evaluating different paths to AI dominance.

Broadcom is a diversified titan with a massive footprint in both chips and infrastructure software. Marvell focuses more narrowly on data infrastructure, providing specialized silicon for cloud and carrier networks. While both benefit from the surge in data center spending, their financial profiles and growth trajectories differ significantly.

The case for Broadcom

Broadcom designs a wide array of semiconductors and infrastructure software for mission-critical needs. The company serves massive end markets including networking, wireless connectivity, and enterprise software. Broadcom maintains high-profile partnerships, including a $30 billion commitment from Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL), though its top five customers account for roughly 40% of revenue.

In the fiscal year ended Nov. 2, 2025, revenue reached nearly $63.9 billion. This was an increase of approximately 23.9% compared with the prior fiscal year. Net income for the period was roughly $23.1 billion, up from approximately $5.9 billion in the previous fiscal year.

Broadcom reported a debt-to-equity ratio of nearly 0.8x in November 2025, which compares total debt to shareholder equity to measure financial leverage. The current ratio, which measures the ability to cover short-term obligations with assets that can be converted to cash quickly, was roughly 1.7x while free cash flow reached nearly $26.9 billion. Note that stock-based compensation represented roughly 27.5% of operating cash flow, which inflates reported cash generation since SBC is a non-cash expense added back in the cash flow statement.

The case for Marvell Technology

Marvell focuses on developing semiconductor solutions specifically for data infrastructure, cloud computing, and carrier networks. The company maintains a strategic multi-year partnership with GlobalFoundries (NASDAQ:GFS) and provides essential silicon for major cloud providers. Marvell is benefiting from the broader interest in semiconductor stocks as data center infrastructure scales up.

In the fiscal year ended Jan. 31, 2026, revenue reached nearly $8.2 billion. This represents growth of roughly 42.1% compared with the prior fiscal year. Net income reached nearly $2.7 billion, a significant improvement over the net loss reported in the prior fiscal year.

Story Continues

As of its January 2026 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio is roughly 0.3x. The current ratio is approximately 2.0x, indicating a strong short-term liquidity position, while free cash flow was nearly $1.4 billion for the year. Note that stock-based compensation represented roughly 33.8% of operating cash flow, which inflates reported cash generation since SBC is a non-cash expense added back in the cash flow statement.

Risk profile comparison

Broadcom faces substantial risks from its heavy reliance on TSMC, which produced approximately 95% of its wafers in the latest fiscal year. The highly cyclical nature of the industry creates potential for volatility or order cancellations during technology shifts. The company also manages an ongoing EU antitrust challenge regarding its VMware acquisition and carries significant debt from its various mergers.

Marvell depends heavily on a small group of customers, with its top ten accounting for nearly 82% of net revenue. This concentration leaves the business vulnerable to delays, such as the recently reported wait for incremental revenue from a major cloud partnership. The company also faces intense competition from Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) and Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) in the market for AI-driven networking hardware.

Valuation comparison

Broadcom appears to be the more conservatively valued option based on earnings, while Marvell commands a higher premium due to its faster revenue growth.

I'd go with Broadcom. Both companies are winning in AI semiconductors, but Broadcom's locked-in revenue commitments stretching years into the future give it a level of visibility that make it a standout in this fast-moving industry. news.Title: Why MongoDB Sank Today
news.Content:
Shares of new-age database company MongoDB (NASDAQ: MDB) sank as much as 26.9% on Monday, before recovering to a 18.5% decline on the day.

Today, MongoDB's CEO, Chirantan "CJ" Desai, announced that he has left MongoDB to head the new Meta Enterprise Platform, which Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META) also announced today.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

It's pretty shocking to see a CEO who was just one year into his tenure leave for a large Magnificent Seven company where he won't be the CEO. Therefore, it's no surprise to see MongoDB falling in the news. But is the sell-off overdone?

Desai departs, and Meta aims for the enterprise

Today, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced the new enterprise venture in a news release, saying that the new platform will:

... use our strengths that few other companies have: advanced models, leading agents, large-scale infrastructure, and years of working closely with many businesses. Initially, we will focus on bringing our full technology stack, including the Muse agent, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code, and more to businesses and developers to help them grow.

It's unclear exactly which products Meta Enterprise will build or augment around Muse, the personal agent that Meta launched on Sept. 8. Meta's advertising empire serves many small businesses, which use its social media platforms to reach customers in highly targeted ways. It appears Meta may be looking to expand into building AI-powered business software for its advertisers, away from its traditional consumer focus.

In a statement, Desai said, "Our goal is to make Meta the place enterprises come to scale their businesses. I'm incredibly grateful for the opportunity and looking forward to working with our customers along this journey."

Fortunately for MongoDB, its ex-CEO, Dev Ittycheria, who served as CEO for 11 years between 2014 and 2025, has been an active Board member since his retirement last year. So, MongoDB will still be run by an experienced hand until the Board finds an appropriate successor.

Will Meta compete with MongoDB?

It's somewhat unclear what additional products Meta Enterprise will develop, and whether Meta will develop a competing database. MongoDB is a database software company, but Desai isn't necessarily an expert solely on databases. He also spent years working for Cloudflare and ServiceNow , whose portfolios span multiple enterprise software and infrastructure offerings. Therefore, Meta Enterprise may become a greater threat to small-business software companies. Of note, many SaaS companies are also down today on the news.

Story Continues

MongoDB will actually hold an Investor Day tomorrow. Interested investors should tune in to learn more about the path forward and how MongoDB aims to both capitalize on the opportunities and mitigate the threats posed by the AI era.
